purpose: Teach: 情念/一躍/余力/立脚/密教/縛り/着色/周回

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、詩人の情念を描いた研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you wrote a paper on the emotional intensity of poets, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone. Gentle opening — she's inviting Sakura to share. Measured pace. Teacher-to-student, but genuinely interested, not checking a box.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、一躍有名になった作家を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about a writer who suddenly became famous.
lines.style: Respectful, direct. Slightly guarded at first — testing the teacher's sincerity. Clear enunciation. Not rehearsed, but careful.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下に余力のない国家の政策を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined state policy during wartime, when the nation had no resources to spare.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slower. Not lecturing — reflecting back what she's heard. Warm but observant, like she's piecing something together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、現代思想が立脚する古典哲学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at classical philosophy that modern thought is built on.
lines.style: Gaining confidence slightly. Still respectful but more present. A small opening, like she's starting to trust the question.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 密教の歴史的展開を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You studied the historical development of esoteric Buddhism.
lines.style: Engaged, genuinely interested now. Slight forward lean in the voice. The pace picks up slightly — she's connecting dots.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、女性を縛りつけた歴史的制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the historical institutions that confined women.
lines.style: Firmer now. The guardedness drops. There's conviction underneath — this matters to her. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古文書の着色研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you researched the colorization techniques used in ancient documents.
lines.style: Reflective, almost marveling. Slower pace. The teacher is clearly delighted by the range. Warm surprise in the tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、衛星が地球を周回する軌道を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about the orbital mechanics of satellites circling Earth.
lines.style: Quick, almost defiant. A small smile underneath. She's proving something — that these topics matter just as much. Confident close.
